name: Crowd figures with simple avoidance
body: Faceless shadow figures on lanes, each with a speed and phase, who step aside from the player and from her. Instanced draws are the aim; the game API has no mesh instancing yet, so the prototype uses one small entity per figure and the gap is a card on engine-follow-ups.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-21 before any code, from Dean's 'Gameplay Direction: Finding Her' doc (searching as the core mechanic, not a platformer).

acceptance_criteria: A festival has dozens of figures flowing along lanes
Figures give way to the player and to her
A figure can turn its head toward her trace
